name: limits-meter
description: Session (5 h) and weekly usage limits as small progress bars with reset countdowns, plus whether the prompt cache is still warm and for how long and the session's name, centred under the prompt; /limits hides or shows them

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache lifetime
cacheTtl.description: How long the prompt cache stays warm after a response: 5m (the API's default) or 1h (an hour, which some accounts get). Claude Code doesn't tell mods which applies, so the cache countdown counts down from this.
